research.hook: Ever felt like your phone knows you better than your roommate does? 🤔 Let’s spend 60 seconds inside a typical day of a student who can’t log off.
research.tip: The 20‑20‑20‑Break: after 20 minutes of continuous gaming or scrolling, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds and stand up for a quick 20‑second stretch.

data.title: Phone aur Gaming Overload: Neend, Stress, Akelaapan
data.title_en: Phone & Gaming Overload: Sleep, Stress, Isolation

scenes.text: Kabhi socha ki phone tumse zyada sochta hai?
scenes.text_en: Ever wondered if your phone thinks more than you?

scenes.text: Delhi ke engineering student Rohan subah class, lunch break, shaam ko gaming start.
scenes.text_en: Delhi engineering student Rohan has morning classes, lunch break, then gaming in the evening.

scenes.text: Raat ko 10 baje tak game, phir phone scroll—par kya aap jaante hain ki isse aapki neend kitni delay ho sakti hai?
scenes.text_en: Playing games until 10 pm, then scrolling—do you know how much this can delay your sleep?

scenes.text: Research ke mutabik, shaam ki gaming neend ko delay karti hai.
scenes.text_en: Research shows evening gaming delays sleep.

scenes.text: Zyada internet use se stress badh sakta hai.
scenes.text_en: Higher internet use can raise stress levels.

scenes.text: Digital overload se face‑to‑face milna kam, akelaapan badhta.
scenes.text_en: Digital overload reduces face‑to‑face contact and increases isolation.

scenes.text: Ab ek chhota break plan try karo.
scenes.text_en: Now try a small break plan.

scenes.text: 20‑20‑20‑Break: 20 minute game, 20 feet door, 20 second stretch.
scenes.text_en: 20‑20‑20‑Break: 20 minutes gaming, look 20 feet away, stretch 20 seconds.

scenes.text: Aaj raat sirf ek 20‑second stretch karo, feel difference.
scenes.text_en: Tonight do just a 20‑second stretch and feel the difference.

scenes.text: Thodi break se neend better, stress kam, doston ke saath time.
scenes.text_en: A short break improves sleep, lowers stress, and frees time with friends.

scenes.text: Toh har 20 minute baad, 20‑20‑20 break lo, aur apni digital life balance karo.
scenes.text_en: So every 20 minutes, take a 20‑20‑20 break and balance your digital life.

data.description: Explore how evening gaming and constant internet use affect sleep, stress, and social life, and learn a simple 20‑20‑20 break to restore balance.
